name: The Bible
solves: recover the earliest wording of a text copied by hand many times
place a text in the time it was written

tools.name: Textual criticism
tools.does: weighs variant readings to recover the earliest text
hypotheses: rules such as preferring the harder reading are rules of thumb

tools.name: Historical-critical exegesis
tools.does: reads the text as a document of its period
hypotheses: the text can be dated and placed
the results are historical and settle no doctrinal question
